correctness.rationale: After one common affine normalization, equal volume gives a_1 a_2 a_3=1. The exact Minkowski polynomial of axis-aligned boxes yields the two defining mixed-volume equalities for every coordinate-ratio pair. Weighted Cauchy--Schwarz plus the coordinate support constraints identifies the logarithmic midpoint M_0 exactly as the coordinatewise geometric-mean box. The arithmetic midpoint M_1 has coordinate ratios lambda_q=(sqrt(a_q)+1/sqrt(a_q))/2 relative to M_0, so its mixed-volume polynomial proves both conjectural inequalities with equality. Simultaneous equality in the two B_3 defining inequalities fixes all elementary symmetric polynomials of (t_1,t_2,1/(t_1t_2)), forcing that multiset to equal {a_1,a_2,a_3}. The finite checker is only a consistency check.

value.rationale: The source proposes generalized radii specifically as a mechanism for attacking three-dimensional Dar and log-Brunn--Minkowski problems. Common-facet parallelotopes form a natural non-homothetic equality family, so an exact verification with explicit generalized radii is a meaningful calibration of the new mechanism. Simultaneous equality in both defining and both conjectural inequalities shows the proposed structure is exactly tuned on this family, and the elementary-symmetric-polynomial argument gives a natural complete classification of its sharp defining witnesses.
